import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    amount = pd.to_numeric(df["amount"], errors="coerce")
    tax = pd.to_numeric(df["tax"], errors="coerce")

    amount_null = df["amount"].isna()
    tax_null = df["tax"].isna()

    r1 = amount_null | (amount < 0)
    r2 = tax_null | (tax < 0)
    r3 = (~amount_null & ~tax_null) & (tax > amount * 0.5)
    r4 = df["due_date"].isna()

    ref = df["customer_ref"]
    ref_is_null = ref.isna()
    ref_trimmed = ref.astype(str).str.strip()
    r5 = ref_is_null | ((~ref_is_null) & (ref_trimmed == ""))

    rule_flags = [
        (r1, "AMT_BAD"),
        (r2, "TAX_BAD"),
        (r3, "TAX_EXCESS"),
        (r4, "DUE_NULL"),
        (r5, "REF_EMPTY"),
    ]

    def build_codes(idx):
        codes = []
        for flag, code in rule_flags:
            if bool(flag.iloc[idx]):
                codes.append(code)
        return "|".join(codes)

    reason_codes = [build_codes(i) for i in range(len(df))]
    reason_series = pd.Series(reason_codes, index=df.index)

    has_failure = reason_series != ""

    clean = df.loc[~has_failure].copy()
    rejects = df.loc[has_failure].copy()
    rejects["reason_codes"] = reason_series.loc[has_failure]

    return {
        "invoices_clean": clean.reset_index(drop=True),
        "invoices_rejects": rejects.reset_index(drop=True),
    }
